wire.t: Oct 30: Week 8 is underway. Early scoring has Breece'sBurdenDeflowered at 35.20 (Josh Jacobs 23.2) against Lead Nagger at 0.00, Wild Goose Chase at 34.60 against NjigbaR Please! at 11.80 (Travis Kelce), and Stroud of Turin at 34.50 against MY DAD IS DEAD at 0.00.

Oct 28: Br0phy and RedDevil904 swapped two for two Wednesday night. Wild Goose Chase gets CeeDee Lamb (24.4 Sunday) and RJ Harvey (15.0); Stroud of Turin gets Ja'Marr Chase (17.2) and Chuba Hubbard (10.0).

Oct 26: ChuckJ10 and rtmcruise pulled the trigger on the only trade of the week. Nothing to see here gets Bucky Irving (24.0 for rtmcruise on Sunday) and Michael Wilson; Breece'sBurdenDeflowered gets A.J. Brown and Chase Brown.

Oct 27: Week 7 is final. Breece'sBurdenDeflowered led the league at 160.90, Lead Nagger had the low at 91.26, and Ivefallenandicantgetup beat Achane in the Membrane by 5.30, the tightest win of the week and the By a C-Hair payout for krunkdd.

Oct 27: Week 8 byes are the Texans, Saints, Giants and 49ers. That hits Lawrence of a Labia (Christian McCaffrey, George Kittle), NjigbaR Please! (Tyler Shough, Alvin Kamara), MY DAD IS DEAD (Chris Olave, Travis Etienne Jr.) and Stroud of Turin (C.J. Stroud).
Oct 27: Omar Cooper Jr. is back from a month on IR with back-to-back 100-yard games (6-103-1, 5-115-1) and is the top waiver add this week. He scored 22.5 starting for Stroud of Turin on Sunday.
Oct 27: Brenton Strange is averaging the sixth-most targets among tight ends over the last month (7-95-0, 7-68-0, 5-44-0), with Kittle and Likely on bye. Bill_Buttlicker owns him and Kittle.

Oct 27: Christian McCaffrey's quad injury is expected to be fine by Week 9, and Kaelon Black ran 12 times for 63 yards and a touchdown while he was out. McCaffrey went for 22.0 for Lawrence of a Labia on Sunday.

stories.title: Week 8 early returns: three teams are already running away while the rest of you haven't scored yet
stories.dek: Breece'sBurdenDeflowered, Wild Goose Chase and Stroud of Turin all have 34-plus on the board. Everybody else is waiting on Sunday.
body: The early Week 8 scoreboard is lopsided. Breece'sBurdenDeflowered sits at 35.20 against Lead Nagger's 0.00, Wild Goose Chase is at 34.60 against NjigbaR Please! at 11.80, and Stroud of Turin is at 34.50 against MY DAD IS DEAD at 0.00. Those three are comfortably up before the Sunday slate starts.

Josh Jacobs is the biggest piece of it with 23.2 for rtmcruise. Achane in the Membrane has 20.9 on the board against Nothing to see here's 0.00. NjigbaR Please! got 11.8 from Travis Kelce and nothing else yet.

None of this is final. Lawrence of a Labia and Bijan is your daddy haven't scored a point, and Bill_Buttlicker's Brenton Strange plan is still the entire season in one start. Llamageddon and Ivefallenandicantgetup are also at zero, so the 4-3 and 5-2 standings still mean something until Sunday.

Standings are unchanged from yesterday: NjigbaR Please!, Ivefallenandicantgetup, Breece'sBurdenDeflowered and Lawrence of a Labia are all 5-2, and the Nov. 10 deadline is 11 days out. Check the Trade Desk if you want to make a move before Sunday.

stories.title: Br0phy sends Ja'Marr Chase and Chuba Hubbard to RedDevil904 for CeeDee Lamb and RJ Harvey
stories.dek: Wild Goose Chase and Stroud of Turin swapped two for two on Wednesday night, a week before the Nov. 10 deadline starts looking real.
body: The Sleeper log has it: Br0phy sends Ja'Marr Chase and Chuba Hubbard to RedDevil904, and RedDevil904 sends back CeeDee Lamb and RJ Harvey. Both managers consented, so nobody has to veto anybody.

On Sunday's numbers it is a wash with a slight lean to Wild Goose Chase. Lamb went for 24.4 and Harvey for 15.0 in RedDevil904's 147.72, a combined 39.4. Chase (17.2) and Hubbard (10.0) gave Br0phy 27.2 in a 107.34 loss to Lawrence of a Labia.

Stroud of Turin is 4-3 and picks up a receiver and a back for a team that is already the best in the league at hanging 147 on people. Wild Goose Chase is also 4-3 with the most points in the league (941.92) and is now the proud owner of one fewer reason to blame the lineup.

Week 8 shows the first test: Wild Goose Chase is a 9.5-point favorite over NjigbaR Please!, and Stroud of Turin has to play MY DAD IS DEAD with C.J. Stroud on the Texans' bye. Sleeper lists Chase as questionable, so RedDevil904 gets to find out how the new guy feels about that.

stories.title: Breece'sBurdenDeflowered hung 160.90 and the commish is 5-2 with a negative point differential
stories.dek: Week 7 is final: Breece'sBurdenDeflowered beat MY DAD IS DEAD by 64.12, Stroud of Turin dropped 147.72 on Nothing to see here, and krunkdd takes the By a C-Hair money.
body: Breece'sBurdenDeflowered finished at 160.90, the top score of the week, and beat MY DAD IS DEAD 96.78 for a +64.12 margin. rtmcruise got Zay Flowers (28.7), Bucky Irving (24.0), Luther Burden III (23.7) and Josh Jacobs (20.1) and is 5-2 with the lowest points-against in the league (725.16). Nobody has had an easier road.

Stroud of Turin put up 147.72 on Nothing to see here (105.02), with CeeDee Lamb at 24.4, Amon-Ra St. Brown at 24.2 and Quinshon Judkins at 23.4. Omar Cooper Jr. added 22.5. RedDevil904 is 4-3 and quietly has the second-best score of the week. Meanwhile ChuckJ10 left 59.8 on the bench, including Rhamondre Stevenson (23.5) and Caleb Douglas (22.0), and lost by 42.70. Same movie, new week.

The closest game was Ivefallenandicantgetup 100.90 over Achane in the Membrane 95.60. krunkdd gets the By a C-Hair payout with a 5.30 margin. MakeItRains started Patrick Mahomes (6.0) with Kirk Cousins (20.4) on the bench; the swap alone is a 14.4-point gain and a 110.00 to 100.90 win. Llamageddon also beat Bijan is your daddy 129.44 to 120.38, the highest-scoring loss of the week, so FatMikeR gets the bad beat. And Pudge247 had the low at 91.26 with a -3.0 defense and Roschon Johnson (1.3) in the lineup and Emanuel Wilson (18.5) on the bench.

Yes, Bill_Buttlicker is writing about his own team. Lawrence of a Labia beat Wild Goose Chase 135.18 to 107.34 and is 5-2, but has scored 795.68 and allowed 800.60. That's a 5-2 team with a negative point differential. It's the luckiest record in the league and the all-play (36-41) says it. Week 8 is a bye for Christian McCaffrey and George Kittle, so enjoy the standings while they last.

stories.title: Achane in the Membrane lost by 5.30 with Kirk Cousins (20.4) on the bench
stories.dek: MakeItRains started Patrick Mahomes for 6.0 and sits at 1-6. The benched QB would have been the whole difference.
body: Achane in the Membrane scored 95.60 and lost to Ivefallenandicantgetup 100.90. MakeItRains started Patrick Mahomes, who put up 6.0. On the bench: Kirk Cousins at 20.4. Swap them and it's 110.00 to 100.90, a win by 9.10. That's the entire season's frustration in one lineup spot.
It wasn't the only miss. Blake Corum had 17.1 on the bench while Mark Andrews (5.3) and the Rams defense (2.0) started. Achane in the Membrane left 40.88 on the bench total.

Then there's the $49 FAAB bid. MakeItRains spent it on David Montgomery in the Week 7 run. Montgomery was reported out for Week 7, the Texans are on bye in Week 8, and he was running 2.7 yards per carry through five games per RotoBaller. He scored 0.0 on the Achane in the Membrane bench. Week 9 is the earliest he's a lineup question. The bid is the problem, not the guy.

Achane in the Membrane has the second-most points scored of any team under .500 (825.92) and is 1-6. It also has 925.06 points against, the most in the league, so the schedule has been rough, but the all-play record is 33-44 and the QB slot is the first thing to fix.

feature.title: Week 7: 160.90 is the new bar and a 5-2 team has a negative point differential
body: Breece'sBurdenDeflowered had the top score of the week at 160.90 and beat MY DAD IS DEAD 96.78 by 64.12. Stroud of Turin was next at 147.72 and Lawrence of a Labia third at 135.18. The league average was 117.46. Only five teams cracked 120.

Ivefallenandicantgetup beat Achane in the Membrane by 5.30, the closest game of the week. That's the By a C-Hair payout for krunkdd. MakeItRains had Kirk Cousins (20.4) on the bench behind Patrick Mahomes (6.0) in a game decided by 5.30.

Bijan is your daddy lost by 9.06 with 120.38, which would have outscored seven of the other eleven teams. FatMikeR gets the bad beat. Llamageddon got Puka Nacua (21.8), Tre Tucker (21.3) and Jonathan Taylor (19.0) and is 3-4.

Lead Nagger had the low at 91.26 and went 0-11 in all-play. Pudge247 is 4-3 on the strength of earlier weeks. Lead Nagger's defense scored -3.0 and the team dropped it Monday along with Roschon Johnson.

rankings.take: Jaxon Smith-Njigba put up 31.3 and dstafford4254 won by 27.76 with KC Concepcion (23.2) on the bench. Tyler Shough and Alvin Kamara are on the Saints' bye, so Week 8 is a real test.

inj: Aaron Jones Sr. (knee), on the Week 8 injury list

body: Br0phy has the most points in the league (941.92) and the best all-play record (51-26) and is 4-3. Drake Maye (28.44) led the 135.18-107.34 loss to Lawrence of a Labia, which is a sentence nobody expected. Wild Goose Chase is still carrying four quarterbacks in a one-QB league: Maye, J.J. McCarthy, Jordan Love (16.96 on the bench) and Bryce Young. Br0phy then traded Ja'Marr Chase and Chuba Hubbard to RedDevil904 for CeeDee Lamb and RJ Harvey.

Wild Goose Chase left 68.26 on the bench, the most in the league Sunday, and that includes 12.0 from a defense it wasn't using. Aaron Jones Sr. (knee) is on the Week 8 injury list and McCarthy is on the Giants' bye. NjigbaR Please! is a 9.5-point dog in Week 8, and the Wild Goose Chase roster is still the one to beat.

teams.name: Ivefallenandicantgetup
inj: Lamar Jackson, ruled out for Week 7 (Ravens); Week 8 status unconfirmed
body: krunkdd is 5-2 and 49-28 in all-play with the By a C-Hair payout, 100.90 to 95.60 over Achane in the Membrane. Geno Smith (23.48) filled in with Josh Allen on bye and Lamar Jackson ruled out, and Javonte Williams went for 21.5 after a 0.00 on Sunday morning. The lineup call that was a mess on Sunday worked out.

Ivefallenandicantgetup has four real running backs (Derrick Henry, Javonte Williams, James Cook III, Bhayshul Tuten) and a thin receiver room. Week 8 against Llamageddon is a 1.5-point game and Josh Allen is back from his bye. The only question is who starts at QB, and krunkdd finally has a good answer.

teams.name: NjigbaR Please!
body: dstafford4254 is 5-2 and 50-27 in all-play. Jaxon Smith-Njigba had 31.3 in a 119.02-91.26 win over Lead Nagger, and KC Concepcion (23.2) sat on the bench for the win. The Jaxon Smith-Njigba pick is the reason this team is where it is.

Week 8 is where it gets weird: Tyler Shough and Alvin Kamara are on the Saints' bye, Kaelon Black is on the 49ers' bye, and NjigbaR Please! is a 9.5-point dog to Wild Goose Chase. dstafford4254 has Travis Kelce and Ashton Jeanty to lean on, plus a bench with 57.96 on it. Somebody's finding a QB.

body: Pudge247 had the low score of the week (91.26) and went 0-11 in all-play. Joe Burrow (28.88) and Tee Higgins (26.8) delivered. The rest of the lineup had a -3.0 defense, Roschon Johnson at 1.3 and Jaylin Noel at 2.98. Emanuel Wilson went for 18.5 on the bench.

Pudge247 dropped Roschon Johnson and the Carolina defense on Monday, which is the one thing about this lineup that made sense. Lead Nagger is 4-3 on the strength of earlier weeks. Week 8 against Breece'sBurdenDeflowered is a 2.5-point game, and Isaiah Likely is on the Giants' bye.

Week 8 is a double bye: Christian McCaffrey and George Kittle are both 49ers. Brenton Strange (7-95-0, 7-68-0, 5-44-0 recently) is the TE fix. Bijan is your daddy is a 2.5-point favorite. Bill_Buttlicker is allowed to complain about this one.

teams.name: Breece'sBurdenDeflowered
body: rtmcruise scored 160.90, the top score of the week, on a 96.78 opponent. Zay Flowers (28.7), Bucky Irving (24.0), Luther Burden III (23.7) and Josh Jacobs (20.1) did it. Breece'sBurdenDeflowered is 5-2 with the lowest points-against in the league (725.16).

columns.title: BR0PHY TRADED CEEDEE LAMB'S OWNER A CEEDEE LAMB! WAIT. NO. THE OTHER WAY!
columns.dek: Two-for-two on a Wednesday night and nobody in the press box can tell who won.
body: Sit DOWN. Br0phy and RedDevil904 made a trade at ONE IN THE MORNING eastern time, and I have read the transaction log SIX TIMES. Wild Goose Chase gets CeeDee Lamb and RJ Harvey. Stroud of Turin gets Ja'Marr Chase and Chuba Hubbard. TWO FOR TWO!

Here are the numbers, and they are REAL. Lamb scored 24.4 on Sunday. Harvey scored 15.0. That's 39.4 coming to Br0phy. Chase gave Br0phy 17.2 and Hubbard 10.0. That's 27.2 going to RedDevil904. Does that make it a winner for Wild Goose Chase? ONE WEEK! ONE WEEK OF DATA!

And look at what Br0phy is doing! Wild Goose Chase has the most points in the league at 941.92 and is only 4-3 and STILL goes out and makes the team better! That's the sign of a manager who is NOT SATISFIED! Meanwhile Stroud of Turin is 44-33 in all-play and ALSO went shopping! EVERYBODY is working!
The deadline is Nov. 10. We have DAYS. Somebody is going to look dumb. I just don't know who yet. And I'm LOVING IT. SEE YOU TOMORROW.

columns.title: I watched the Lamb-for-Chase tape. Br0phy got the better of it and RedDevil904 got soft.
body: I put the Sleeper box scores on. Not the NFL tape, the box scores, because that's what this trade is about. Br0phy sent Ja'Marr Chase and Chuba Hubbard to RedDevil904. RedDevil904 sent back CeeDee Lamb and RJ Harvey.
Lamb put up 24.4 in the lineup on Sunday. Chase put up 17.2. Harvey had 15.0 and Hubbard had 10.0. The side getting Lamb gets 39.4 of last week's production and the side giving him up gets 27.2.

RedDevil904 owns the team that scored 147.72 and gave up its best number for a guy who is listed questionable on Sleeper. Soft. You trade down when you're 4-3 and have the second-best score of the week? Soft.
Wild Goose Chase still has four quarterbacks in a one-QB league. That's soft too. But at least Br0phy is out here acting like winning the thing is the goal. Both of them are 4-3. Prove it Sunday.

columns.title: Klozoff's 5 Moves to Win Week 8 (Guaranteed, Again)
columns.dek: The Texans, Saints, Giants and 49ers are off, which is great news if you think about it for exactly one second.
body: 1. START EVERYBODY ON BYE. Four teams are off this week: Texans, Saints, Giants, 49ers. That's rest. Rested players score more. Lawrence of a Labia has Christian McCaffrey and George Kittle both on bye, which means they'll be at their sharpest on Sunday. I assume. Start them both.

2. ChuckJ10, bench anyone who scores more than 20. Rhamondre Stevenson put up 23.5 on the bench last week and Caleb Douglas put up 22.0. That's a lot of points for someone you're not playing. If you keep starting them, you'll run out of players to bench. Math.

3. MakeItRains should spend all the FAAB on David Montgomery every week. Paying $49 once is a mistake. Paying it 14 times is a strategy. His 2.7 yards per carry tells me he's got a lot of room to grow. Up is the only direction.

4. RedDevil904, you have Aaron Rodgers filling in for C.J. Stroud this week. C.J. Stroud is on bye. Rename your team 'Rodgers of Turin' to confuse the other managers. I don't know how this helps but I feel strongly about it.

5. Pudge247, you started a -3.0 defense and it was a mistake. The fix is to start the defense that's scoring NEGATIVE points more often, so that the average comes down to a place where positive numbers are noticed. This is called 'lowering the bar.' I'm in my lawn chair and I've never been more sure.

columns.title: Connie Lingus: The data says the best predictor of winning is being the team that already won
columns.dek: I ran Week 7 through the model. The model is a spreadsheet and the spreadsheet has feelings.
body: Welcome to the numbers. The league average in Week 7 was 117.46 points. Five of twelve teams scored above 120, which is 41.7 percent, and that's the most reliable percentage I've ever read. The top score was 160.90 (Breece'sBurdenDeflowered). The low was 91.26 (Lead Nagger). The spread between them is 69.64 points.

Here's the finding. Lead Nagger scored 91.26 and went 0-11 in all-play. Wild Goose Chase has the most points in the league (941.92) and went 4-3. Ivefallenandicantgetup has 885.88 points and is 5-2. If you plot points against wins, the correlation is 'sometimes.' I've decided that 'sometimes' is a statistically significant result.

Now the part I'm proudest of. Lawrence of a Labia is 5-2 with 795.68 points for and 800.60 against, a point differential of -4.92. That's the only 5-2 team with a negative number. My model says this means Bill_Buttlicker has the best luck in the league, which means he should be the favorite in every game he plays. Week 8 he's a 2.5-point underdog to Bijan is your daddy. The model has been informed and the model disagrees.

Final note. Achane in the Membrane lost by 5.30 with 14.4 points of difference between Patrick Mahomes (6.0) and Kirk Cousins (20.4). My spreadsheet says 14.4 minus 5.30 is 9.10, and 9.10 is a small number. The sample is one game, and I have never doubted a sample size of one. See you next week.

commish.title: Contacts for Your Mom
commish.dek: The two men who run this league, collect your money, and answer to no one.

body: The winningest manager in Addicks history, the man who built this website, and somehow still without a ring. Bill_Buttlicker has 65 regular-season wins, six playoff trips in seven years, and a 2019 final he'd rather not talk about.
He runs the league, sets the payouts, and writes the newsletter that roasts all of you. He also scored 214.54 in 2019 Week 5, the second-highest week in league history. Respect the office.

The first champion in Addicks history. ChuckJ10 won it all in 2019, made the final again in 2021, and went 11-3 as last year's top seed. He has the ring the commissioner doesn't, and he's the second-winningest manager of all time.
This season has been a different story, and the co-commish has been on the receiving end of more than a few A.N.A.L. headlines. Fortunately, he has the authority to overturn none of them.
The thirteenth man in a twelve-team league and the voice of the auction. marco_polo doesn't own a team, which is the only reason nobody has accused him of rigging the bidding.
He opens the bidding, calls the room to order and decides when the hammer drops. Ask him a question and he answers faster than anyone in the league can think about it. Respect the gavel.

tradehist.analysis: Br0phy and RedDevil904 swapped two for two on Oct 29. CeeDee Lamb scored 24.4 and RJ Harvey 15.0 last Sunday, against 17.2 for Ja'Marr Chase and 10.0 for Chuba Hubbard. No Week 8 games have been played for this deal yet, so the verdict comes after Sunday.

ChuckJ10 got Bucky Irving, who scored 24.0 for rtmcruise the Sunday before the deal, plus Michael Wilson. rtmcruise got A.J. Brown and Chase Brown. Neither side has played a game with its new players, so the verdict waits for Week 8 scoring.
